certificate.description: The Infinidat Cryptographic Module is a set of cryptographic libraries that implement TLS , symmetric key generation and encryption/decryption, and SED authentication key derivation for the InfuzeOS , which is the core component of the InfiniBox and InfiniBox SSA appliances. The Infinidat Cryptographic Module comes pre-installed on each InfiniBox node.
